name: neon-gradient-card

frames.best_why: Full card with the gradient border at its widest colour spread, pink at the top shading into a bright cyan halo.

tagline: Card border drifts through pink and cyan with a soft coloured halo.
summary: A dark rounded card whose thin border runs a pink-to-teal gradient that slides and pulses endlessly, throwing a blurred glow onto the backdrop. The content sits untouched inside.
appearance: A near-black rounded rectangle centred on a very dark stage. Its thin border carries a magenta-to-cyan gradient and casts a soft coloured haze onto the surrounding backdrop. Three lines of heavy gradient text fill the inside.
behaviour: The gradient slides up and down the border on a slow three-second loop that alternates direction, and the blurred halo outside shifts with it. The card itself never reacts to the pointer or clicks.
demo_content: The heavy three-line text reads "Neon Gradient Card".
search_phrases: neon frame around a content box
glowing halo behind a dark panel
use_when: A promo or feature card should feel high-energy on an already dark page.
avoid_when: Light themes: the glow and gradient border wash out against pale backgrounds.
customise: Border thickness, corner radius and the two neon colours are props; the inner background, padding and animation timing need a source edit.
weight_why: Two pseudo-elements driven by one CSS keyframe loop; no canvas or JS animation.

a11y.note: Decorative and non-interactive; the endless glow ignores prefers-reduced-motion.

polish_why: Crisp gradient border and a believable glow; the demo shows only text, hiding the card body.
